owner_and_source: Geofabrik GmbH extract of OpenStreetMap (download.geofabrik.de), District of Columbia
license_and_commercial_rights: ODbL 1.0 (OpenStreetMap); commercial use permitted with attribution and share-alike on derived databases
schema_and_format: OSM PBF (protobuf) -- nodes/ways/relations for road network extraction; small on-point extract to prove the routing/networks estate before pulling a full metro
update_frequency: daily upstream; re-pull on demand, not scheduled
canonical_contract: none-yet (raw routing input; a normalized road-graph derived artifact is future Program F/H work)

quality_tests.name: pbf_magic
quality_tests.description: retained object begins with a valid OSM PBF blob header (non-empty, >1KB)

acceptance_threshold: downloads, non-empty, > 1 MB (a DC extract is ~20 MB; a truncated download would be far smaller)
retention_and_deletion: expensive-but-reproducible (re-fetchable from Geofabrik); evict before audit/contractual records
